defaults.outputFormat: 48kHz wav master -> ogg 160kbps + m4a mobile fallback
defaults.loudnessNote: music mastered to -16 LUFS, big-win stingers to -14 LUFS, per config/audio-events.json loudnessLufsTarget
defaults.mirrorNote: each entry mirrors the generationPrompt of the same eventId in config/audio-events.json

prompts.prompt: Warm industrial-fantasy underscore for a molten glassworks: hammered dulcimer, low tuned percussion, soft furnace-drone pads, glass chimes; patient and hypnotic; 96 bpm; A minor.

Free-spins layer over the same theme family: driving frame-drum groove, brighter hammered-dulcimer arpeggios, rising ember shimmer; determined, kindled energy; 96 bpm; A minor; must layer cleanly over the base loop's harmonic bed.

Second-tier bonus layer: heavy anvil hits, bellows-swell brass, urgent string ostinato over the established groove; the forge at full roar; 96 bpm; A minor; same harmonic bed as the feature loop with one added intensity layer.

Top-tier bonus peak: full orchestral-hybrid with soaring brass theme, cascading glass-harp runs, thunderous taiko-scale drums; triumphant and incandescent; 96 bpm; A minor; the loudest, densest state in the adaptive set.
Slot reel stop: solid brass thunk with a short glass clink on top, tight and dry, no reverb tail.
First bonus-symbol stinger: single struck glass bell with a warm furnace whoosh underneath, medium pitch, short dry tail.
Second bonus-symbol stinger, escalation step two: two-note rising glass bell motif a third higher than step one, swelling ember crackle underneath, more urgent.
Third bonus-symbol stinger, the trigger moment: triumphant three-note glass bell fanfare resolving upward, deep kiln boom and bright spark burst.
Big win fanfare: bold brass-and-glass-harp flourish with a kiln-boom accent and sparkling glass tail, celebratory, about two and a half seconds.
Win meter count-up loop: rapid soft glass-tick arpeggio, exactly one bar at 96 bpm (2.5 seconds), seamless loop, energetic but never harsh; pairs with a separate beat-quantized terminator hit.
